title: First Annual Pinewood Derby
description: Start your engines! Join us for our First annual Pinewood Derby, featuring both a Children's Class and an Adult Class! Children's cars are FREE and have been generously provided by Brother and Mrs. Croyle. Adults are welcome to race as well and will need to purchase their own car. Parents and grandparents, this is a wonderful opportunity to spend time with your child or grandchild building a car, making memories, and getting ready for race day! Following the morning service, we'll enjoy a church potluck fellowship and then it's time to RACE. Sign-up sheet is the back.
location: Victory Baptist Church - 295 Pleasant View Drive, Kittanning, PA 16201
